purpose: Verify FULL execution, fault billing, and same-semantics service latency on real LLM calls. NOT a claim of algorithm advantage.

tasks.source: hybrid_pool() held-out tasks, excluding all previously used UIDs (P1-B 5 + any data-window usage)
tasks.freeze: UIDs and hashes committed before any real call; no post-hoc task changes
tasks.panel_note: 4 tasks is a mechanism-validation pilot, not a performance experiment; no significance claims

S1_no_recovery.config: DYNAMICDAG node-level: e1=large, e2=large, r=medium, v=coder, Z=NONE
S1_no_recovery.purpose: baseline: all planned nodes execute normally, no recovery events expected

S2_local_reroute.fault: directed r-node syntax fault (synthetic_unparseable_r from P1-B)
S2_local_reroute.purpose: verify local recovery billing: faulted r attempt billed, r_esc new call billed, v_refresh billed if r_changed_final=True
S2_local_reroute.expected_calls: 4 planned + 1 injected + 1-3 recovery (r_esc, v_fbd depending on detection)

S3_full_replay.purpose: verify FULL: entire DAG re-executed from scratch after detection; all nodes get new calls

S4_cache_reuse.purpose: verify legitimate cache reuse: all calls should hit cache from S1; physical new_requests=0

budget.failed_call_billing: infrastructure failures counted toward budget; no automatic retry
budget.budget_reset: prohibited; global counter persisted to disk
budget.output_isolation: each scenario gets an independent run directory with its own ledger, budget, and completion marker

latency_calibration.record: for every call: serial service-demand reconstruction (sum of individual latencies) AND actual wall-clock (time.monotonic between first and last call per task)
latency_calibration.current_scale: L_SCALE=(0,12) is a PLACEHOLDER from Cube critical-path; must be recalibrated from this validation's serial reconstruction data
latency_calibration.calibration_rule: new scale = max(observed serial reconstruction) * 1.4 margin; frozen BEFORE any formal experiment; version-tagged; NOT adjusted using formal test results
latency_calibration.out_of_range: values exceeding frozen scale clipped to [0,1]; clip fraction reported per scenario

acceptance_evidence.per_node_trace: node, model, prompt_sha, raw answer head, parsed result, latency, tokens — for every call
acceptance_evidence.billing_separation: logical_calls, injected_calls, cache_hits, new_requests, new_tokens, new_latency_s — per task per scenario
acceptance_evidence.quality_scoring: Q from JointEvaluator formal path (fence-parsed); gold used only post-hoc
acceptance_evidence.cache_provenance: each cache_hit annotated with source ledger key
acceptance_evidence.hv_improvement: not claimed — this is mechanism validation only

stopping_rules.budget_exhaustion: stop immediately; log partial results with status=aborted-budget
stopping_rules.infrastructure_failure: stop; log failure; NO automatic retry; preserve partial ledger
stopping_rules.protocol_violation: any unexpected call pattern (e.g., S4 producing new requests) → stop and investigate

all_checks: cost predictor Track B: PASSED (Stub level)
48-config space + evaluator + metered executor: PASSED (18/18 unit tests)
outstanding: cost predictor accuracy under real model costs
L scale recalibration from real serial reconstruction data

explicit_non_claims: This validation does NOT prove algorithm advantage
Does NOT compare methods (single method, mechanism focus)
Does NOT establish statistical significance (4 tasks)
Does NOT finalize L scale (placeholder until calibrated)
